items.item_text: BLS through the American Heart Association (AHA)
Bachelor of Science in Nursing or equivalent education and experience or actively pursuing a Bachelor's Degree in Nursing or other-related field (e.g., BSN/BBA/BHA).
Minimum of three (3) years of nursing experience
Recruits and retains and develops qualified and motivated staff members in the Patient Transportation department, while maintaining morale and satisfactory budget and productivity.
Demonstrates effective organizational skills to develop departmental, personal goals, and objectives that address multiple priorities in a complex environment.
Provides efficient oversight of transport service in order to maintain acceptable flow of patients throughout the medical center. Supervise and direct work of subordinates.
Relates cooperatively and constructively with customers -- physicians, patients and families, staff members, and other hospital personnel.
Collaborates with clinical and ancillary department staff and department management, and to facilitate a better understanding of patient care as it relates to their responsibilities.
Provide direct instruction in patient transportation.
